Results.ReviewText:
My dad swears by Weber products. He bought his first Weber grill over 30 years ago and it's still running well. He bought a smaller grill a few years ago though, to have a much smaller grill. 

I absolutely love my Spirit II. It's easy to work, does a phenomenal job grilling and it's easy to move around. 

I bought the iGrill 3, but have found that the sensor probes may come to temperature before the meat does. I intend to figure out what's going on with that. 

I am extremely pleased with the grill overall and have suggested to friends to buy the same (and they have). 

There is nothing like the aroma and taste of grilled vegetables, meat and fish: Weber Grills make sure your food comes out perfect, every time.
Results.Title: Easy to use, fantastic power and heat.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
